name: COMP_008
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (88%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability [F6], {Normal, InSitu} set [F1], and deferred frozen-section margin call [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 88%, Normal 6%, Benign 4%, Invasive 2% | Low invasive risk (2%) |
| Conformal set | {Normal, InSitu} (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.32 (flagged), 88% OOD | Suspect, atypical input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | false (disagree) | Backbones disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 1/5 (20%) InSitu, 4/5 Normal [F5] | Neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest score (-1.43) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes against invasion (-0.78) [F3]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 5, 8) · ↓ invasive · Pushes against invasion (-0.65) [F4]; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 8) · ↑ invasive · Slight pro-invasive push (+0.24); 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score vs random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); relies on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Normal tissue mimics InSitu on this low-reliability composite frozen section (4/5 neighbors Normal; CONCH–MUSK disagree).
- Focal invasion in regions 9 (70% risk) or 4 (57% risk) requires drafted recut or deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 9**: Highest heatmap risk (57%, 70%); inspect for focal stromal invasion versus artifact.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus artifact; consider drafted recut and deeper levels.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 10, 11**: Confirm benign lobules and stroma (0% risk); defer margin call.
